name: LFO - Wavetable
description: This algorithm is a version of the LFO algorithm which uses wavetables for its wave shapes. Please see the section above on how wavetables are formatted and arranged on the MicroSD card.
use_cases: Modulating other parameters with wavetable LFOs
gui_description: The display shows the shape of the current channel's output, or if the 'Globals' page is active, the shape of all the channels.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: Sets the LFO output quality. The options are "Stepped" and "Linear".

parameters.name: Trigger mode
parameters.description: The trigger mode for the channel.

parameters.name: Wave offset
parameters.description: Sets the position within the wavetable.

parameters.name: Speed
parameters.description: Sets the LFO speed, from 0.05Hz to 15Hz with an exponential scaling.

parameters.name: Multiplier
parameters.description: Sets a multiplier for the LFO speed.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: Sets the amplitude of the LFO.

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Adds a constant voltage to the LFO output.

parameters.name: Sync
parameters.description: Selects how the LFO will sync to external clocks or MIDI.

parameters.name: Clock multiplier
parameters.description: Sets the clock multiplier, if syncing to external clocks.

parameters.name: MIDI divisor
parameters.description: Sets the MIDI clock divisor, if syncing to MIDI clock.

input_ports.name: Clock input
input_ports.description: The bus to use as the clock input.

input_ports.name: Reset input
input_ports.description: The bus to use as the reset input.
